title: Lojong Teaching 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of tonight's Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating a mindful and humble approach to life, letting go of ego-driven motivations and conditioning. By practicing mindfulness, developing bodhicitta, and focusing on benefiting all beings without exception, individuals can overcome their habitual patterns and find space in their lives. This involves acknowledging our limitations, taking responsibility for our actions, and interacting with the world in a more open and compassionate way.
